pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pCreative/testing power supply. It replenishes stored FE; it is not intended as a survival progression reward.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place it in a test world.$p2. Enable a permitted output face.$p3. Use it to isolate receiver-side problems, then retest with a finite survival source.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pDo not treat a test with an unlimited source as proof that your normal generator can meet the required throughput.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
